name: Josh Park
summary: QA engineer with 2 years of experience who began in manual testing and moved into automation, writing Selenium and Playwright browser tests in Python and JavaScript for e-commerce checkout flows.
strengths: Hands-on with Selenium and Playwright for end-to-end browser test coverage
Comfortable scripting test cases in both Python and JavaScript
Strong manual-to-automation transition, with attention to flaky-test reduction
gaps: No experience wiring test suites into CI/CD pipelines; tests currently run locally or on a shared runner
Limited API testing experience beyond simple Postman smoke checks
resumeText: At Brightline Commerce I write automated browser tests for the checkout and order flows using Selenium and Playwright. I started as a manual QA tester at Northgate Retail Group and transitioned into automation, teaching myself Python and JavaScript test scripting. My suites cover the core purchase journey and I focus on keeping tests stable and fast, though they still run manually triggered rather than from a CI/CD pipeline.
